connector.name: URL Safety Validator MCP
connector.registryDescription: AI URL safety validator: SAFE/SUSPICIOUS/DANGEROUS verdict, trust score, threat intel.
connector.summary: Hosted at url-safety-validator-mcp-production.up.railway.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package url-safety-validator-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ojaskord account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
